# Fixture index

Generated by `make-index.py` — do not edit by hand. Every row's
purpose is the fixture's own leading comment or docstring, quoted
verbatim; `origin` is the scratch path it was retrieved from.

These are archival copies. Most hardcode `/tmp/...` paths for the
build trees and binaries they were written against, so they will not
run unmodified from this directory — see §12 of
`../IRCITUILIB_TEST_STRATEGIES.md`.
